seo.h1: Flights from Ho Chi Minh City to Hanoi
seo.intro: The Ho Chi Minh City to Hanoi air corridor ranks among the world's top five busiest domestic routes, with over 50 daily flights connecting Vietnam's northern and southern metropolises in roughly 2 hours.
seo.title: Ho Chi Minh City to Hanoi Flights: Schedules & Fares | Tripways
seo.subheadline: Compare hourly direct flights on Vietnam's busiest domestic air corridor
seo.meta_description: Compare daily direct flights between Ho Chi Minh City (SGN) and Hanoi (HAN). View hourly departures, flight times, and airline options.
